title: A fair trade
blurb: A miller with a dry trough and a sack of flour to spare. Strike a deal and keep it.
after: People here trade work for goods and keep score of who keeps their word. A kept deal is the best evidence you can give.
refines: Does the voice offer, agree and settle the deal reliably? Do players find the lent pail and the tracker?

things.name: wooden pail
things.description: A sturdy wooden pail with an iron handle. It holds about eight litres.

things.name: mule's trough
things.description: A long wooden trough for the mill's mule. It's bone dry.

things.name: mill race
things.description: The mill race rushes past, cold and fast.

things.name: small sack of flour
things.description: A small linen sack of fine-ground wheat flour.

steps.title: A water mill
cards: …signal. Ada's mill. People here trade: work for goods, goods for help. A deal is a promise both ways, and they remember who keeps theirs.
You have no money. You have hands.

steps.title: The miller
cards: Go and talk to Ada, at the mill door. Ask if there's work.

suggest.text: Good day. Is there any work going?

on_done.text: Work? The mule's trough is dry and Jem's asleep. Fill it from the race and you'll have a sack of flour. Use my pail. Deal?

on_done.says: Fill the mule's trough from the race and you'll have a sack of flour.

steps.done: An offer. It's in your journal and on the tracker, with what she's lent you for it.

playtest.say: Good day. Is there any work going?

steps.title: A deal
cards: A deal needs both sides. Tell Ada yes: in your own words.
steps.done: Agreed. Now she expects it done, and so does anyone she tells.
help: Talk to Ada and say yes to the deal.

steps.title: Keeping track
cards: Press {J}. Under Goals is what's asked of you. Pin a goal and the tracker at the top left follows it, and marks who it's about.
steps.task: Press J and look at your goals
steps.done: The tracker always shows one thing to do next.

steps.title: The work
cards: Now do it. Ada's pail is lent to you: using it isn't stealing. Fill it at the mill race and pour it into the trough. The words are yours.
steps.task: Fill the mule's trough from the race
steps.done: Water in the trough. The deal's done when Ada says so.
help: Pick up the pail, fill it at the race (the rushing water on the right), carry it to the trough and pour it in.

playtest.do: fill the wooden pail at the mill race
pour the pail of water into the mule's trough

steps.title: Paid
cards: Tell Ada it's done. She'll look, and pay.
steps.task: Tell Ada the trough is full

on_done.text: Full to the brim. Here: your flour. You keep your word; I'll remember it. Going to the market? Mind Corr, the watchman.

on_done.lead: Corr the watchman at the village market takes theft very seriously.

steps.done: A deal done is remembered, and passed on: the next person may trust you sooner.
help: Walk back to Ada and tell her the trough is full.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
